  analyst static, round 1
    isr.technique_line_unread
        said: 1 claim(s) have a TECHNIQUE line that is not technique ids or NONE, so no technique is read from them: "T1055 not supported". Write each claim's technique ids alone, several separated by commas, or NONE when it claims none. An id the claim does not assert (negated, absent, not supported) is left off the line, and the claim sentence says so; a doubt about an id the claim does assert is said in the claim and in its CONFIDENCE.
